name: skill-feedback-writer
tagline_zh: 你的技能输出总差一步？让它自检漏洞。输入结果，它反向揪出缺失指令，连「忘了说保存」这种坑都给你标出来。
tagline_en: Feed it your skill's output, it reverse-engineers the missing instructions—even the 'forgot to save' trap. Try.
desc_en: Use to identify missing instructions in another skill based on its output.
why_zh: 同类工具只测功能，它专测「指令完整性」——从结果反推缺口，连隐性假设都挖出来，像给技能做X光。
why_en: Others test if it works; this one tests if your instructions are complete—reverse-maps gaps from output, exposing hidden.
